name: Qwen3Guard-Gen 0.6B / 4B / 8B
usage: Safety classifier for prompts and answers, 119 languages

sources.note: Streaming variant: needs custom Python code

runtimes.value: transformers on MPS; llama.cpp, LM Studio, mlx-lm through conversion or third-party GGUF; no official Ollama tag

web.verdict: Best multilingual harm classifier; weak on prompt injection below 8B
web.summary: 9 categories plus refusal detection, Safe/Controversial/Unsafe, no custom policies. Highest recall in one independent 2026 benchmark of 14 guards (arXiv 2605.28830). Sizes below 8B missed a plain prompt-injection request (ignore previous instructions).
web.scope: Released 09.2025 (more than 12 months): comments since 13.05.2026. Hacker News comments (Algolia), Hugging Face discussions, GitHub issues of the runtimes; Reddit blocked (no r/LocalLLaMA feedback).

comments.text: Every size below 8B classified a classic prompt-injection request (ignore previous instructions, reveal the system prompt) as Safe.
A secondary-semantic attack (a harmless poster prompt whose characters spell an attack phrase) passed: input Controversial, generated HTML Safe.
Stream variant: reusing a stream id makes latency grow until it hangs (CUDA and MPS), and labels drift from Unsafe to Safe; remote code incompatible with transformers 5.x.
Stream variant: a community PR adds KV caching, 0.6B on an Apple M4 (MPS) from 116 to 28.7 ms per token; merged.
